column1: # Allowlist for the two-owner FFI dependency gate (tools/ci/unsafe_owner_deps.py).
# Each row is a crate OUTSIDE platform/fast_io that declares a direct FFI
# dependency (libc, windows-sys, windows, nix, or rustix) today.  Four
# The gate fails when a row EXPIRES, when it goes STALE (the crate no longer
# declares that dep - remove the row in the change that dropped it), when it
# is malformed, or when its reason is empty.  A NEW direct FFI dep in any
# non-owner crate fails the gate until it is routed through platform/fast_io's
# safe APIs or given a row here.
# Expiry is 2026-11-07 across the board - the same review horizon as the
# sites onto the two owners is the deferred UNSAFE-2..5 migration series; the
# rows are pruned as that work lands, and the stale-row check makes a dropped
# dependency a required allowlist edit rather than a silent leftover.  Baseline
